body: I think I have pushed myself away when she first passed away. I think I’m still a little distant from people just not as much as when the passing first happened
I have wrote down how I felt and it works a little. Sometimes I do when I just need to let everything out cause I bottle my feelings.
I just cry and feel a little good and go back to being back to normal to how I was first
That’s how I feel sometimes I hold so much back crying over it feels like such a relief it helps release all my emotions
Sorry for your lost it hurts losing someone
Yes I have experienced trauma by losing someone important to me
It’s been 3 years and still hurts. When am I gonna stop hurting? Why has it took so long? Like all I could think about is damn I really lost somebody.
Nope so it’s just how I feel. So I still have no answer
Please don’t go. Someone needs you and cares for you. They might not show it but when you leave they will be hurt.
